gifts.note: Deliver the Letter. Mr. Stone gives you a Letter for Steven at Devon Corporation in Rustboro City. Steven waits in the room at the far end of Granite Cave. Hand him the Letter and he gives you the Steel Wing TM, then leaves. Can be missed: if your Bag is full, the TM is lost.

Beat your Dad (Badge 5). The Petalburg Gym Leader battles you once you have the first four badges. After the battle you get TM Package 5 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and an Assault Vest. If your Bag had no room for the Assault Vest, talk to him again.
